data.name: Prasan
data.gender_notes: Prasan is used as a masculine name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is the Lord of Prosperity and the Giver of All Good Things. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Prasad', which means 'to give', and 'an', which means 'Lord'. The name Prasan carries the meaning “Lord of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Prasan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prasan is a name that embodies the essence of prosperity and abundance. It is believed to bring good luck, success, and happiness to those who bear this name.
data.etymology: Prasan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prasan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
